product.outcome: Draw a product flow on a shared canvas, edit its layers, and resolve comments where they belong.

users.who: A designer editing screens on a laptop while teammates review and comment from a phone.

capabilities.note: Create a named board only after persistence acknowledges its identity.
Explicitly save layer property drafts to the current board revision.
Preserve local changes offline and acknowledge synced revisions when connected.
Persist pinned comments and replies with delivery acknowledgement.
Persist a pinned comment’s resolved state.
Remove a confirmed frame and its child layers in one acknowledged revision.
Grant access to the named board and deliver its invitation.
Create a local image export of selected frames.
Persist grid, guide and notification preferences.
Notify opted-in participants about newly persisted comments.
Linked components are unavailable; layers duplicate independently, with no component or detach controls.

boardsReady.label: Recent boards
boardsReady.rule: Sort saved boards by date; keep owner, frame count and review status as separate facts.

boardsLoading.label: Loading boards
boardsLoading.rule: Keep the heading and New board action while fetching saved identities.

boardsEmpty.label: First board
boardsEmpty.rule: Offer a named blank board; no template catalog is implied.

boardsFailed.label: Board list unavailable
boardsFailed.rule: Keep cached boards marked stale and retry without creating duplicates.

boardsLongContent.label: Long board name
boardsLongContent.rule: Wrap the full name without covering owner or review status.

boardsCreated.label: Board created
boardsCreated.rule: Show the acknowledged Autumn launch flow board with zero frames and a stable route.

boardEditorDraft.label: New board draft
boardEditorDraft.rule: Ask only for a name; no blank board exists until save succeeds.

boardEditorSaving.label: Creating board
boardEditorSaving.rule: Retain the name and prevent duplicate creation while awaiting identity.

boardEditorSaved.label: Board saved
boardEditorSaved.rule: Show the acknowledged board name and open its blank canvas.

boardEditorFailed.label: Board not created
boardEditorFailed.rule: Retain the name; retry without opening an unsaved board.

boardEditorLongContent.label: Long board draft
boardEditorLongContent.rule: Keep the full team-authored board name editable.

canvasEditing.label: Editing board
canvasEditing.rule: Render saved layers at their positions; layer body text is user document content, not live app controls.

canvasBlank.label: Blank board
canvasBlank.rule: Open the newly acknowledged board with no layers and offer its first shape, text or note.

canvasSaving.label: Syncing edits
canvasSaving.rule: Keep edited layers visible while the pending revision is sent; do not call them shared yet.

canvasSaved.label: Revision saved
canvasSaved.rule: Show the acknowledged revision and edited button text; these changes are now shared.

canvasOffline.label: Offline edits
canvasOffline.rule: Keep edits on this device and label the pending count; collaborators have not received them.

canvasFailed.label: Sync failed
canvasFailed.rule: Retain all local layer changes and retry syncing this revision.

canvasLongContent.label: Long layer text
canvasLongContent.rule: Wrap full editable text without covering tool controls or losing layer identity.

canvasDeleting.label: Deleting frame
canvasDeleting.rule: Keep the selected Welcome frame visible and disable duplicate deletion until acknowledged.

canvasDeleted.label: Frame removed
canvasDeleted.rule: Remove Welcome and its four child layers only after acknowledging the new revision.

canvasDeleteFailed.label: Frame not removed
canvasDeleteFailed.rule: Keep the frame and its children; retry without discarding unrelated edits.

canvasSharing.label: Sending invitation
canvasSharing.rule: Retain the board and invitation choices while access is being granted.

canvasShared.label: Invitation sent
canvasShared.rule: Confirm access to this board only after acknowledgement.

canvasShareFailed.label: Invitation not sent
canvasShareFailed.rule: Retain the invitation draft; no new access is implied.

canvasExporting.label: Preparing export
canvasExporting.rule: Keep the selected frames while generating the local image.

canvasExported.label: Export ready
canvasExported.rule: Expose the completed image download without changing the board revision.

canvasExportFailed.label: Export failed
canvasExportFailed.rule: Retain selected frames and retry the local export.

layerEditorDraft.label: Layer draft
layerEditorDraft.rule: Edit the selected button’s name, text, dimensions and resizing without mutating the saved layer.

layerEditorSaving.label: Saving layer
layerEditorSaving.rule: Retain every property value and canvas context while preventing duplicate saves.

layerEditorSaved.label: Layer saved
layerEditorSaved.rule: Show the acknowledged button properties and return to the saved board.

layerEditorFailed.label: Layer not saved
layerEditorFailed.rule: Retain the property draft and retry without restoring the old canvas layer.

layerEditorLongContent.label: Long layer draft
layerEditorLongContent.rule: Keep full names, descriptions and text editable beside the canvas.

commentsReady.label: Pinned feedback
commentsReady.rule: Keep comments tied to named layers; a reply does not silently resolve a thread.

commentsLoading.label: Loading comments
commentsLoading.rule: Keep the board route while withholding unconfirmed feedback.

commentsEmpty.label: No pinned feedback
commentsEmpty.rule: Keep the selected layer and offer its first comment.

commentsFailed.label: Comments unavailable
commentsFailed.rule: Keep cached feedback and drafts; fetching again does not imply delivery.

commentsLongContent.label: Long review feedback
commentsLongContent.rule: Wrap the full author and comment text with its pinned-layer route.

commentsSending.label: Posting feedback
commentsSending.rule: Keep the draft pending beside its layer and prevent duplicate posting.

commentsSent.label: Feedback posted
commentsSent.rule: Mark the new pinned comment delivered only after acknowledgement.

commentsSendFailed.label: Feedback not posted
commentsSendFailed.rule: Keep the exact draft with a post retry next to its layer.

commentsResolving.label: Resolving feedback
commentsResolving.rule: Keep the thread open until resolution is acknowledged.

commentsResolved.label: Feedback resolved
commentsResolved.rule: Retain the resolved thread’s history and pinned layer.

commentsResolveFailed.label: Resolution not saved
commentsResolveFailed.rule: Leave the thread open and retry without losing replies.

settingsReady.label: Canvas preferences
settingsReady.rule: Save per-designer grid, guides, comment and export preferences explicitly.

settingsSaving.label: Saving canvas preferences
settingsSaving.rule: Retain changed options and prevent duplicate saves.

settingsSaved.label: Canvas preferences saved
settingsSaved.rule: Confirm choices without changing board content or existing exports.

settingsFailed.label: Preferences not saved
settingsFailed.rule: Retain changed options and offer a local retry.

helpReady.label: Frames and local edits
helpReady.rule: Explain parent-relative layers, pinned comments and local-versus-shared changes; linked components are unavailable.

landingReady.label: About Tilework
landingReady.rule: Explain boards, independently editable layers and pinned feedback; start at the board collection.

emailBoardInvitationReady.label: Board access invitation
emailBoardInvitationReady.rule: Name the board and inviter after access is granted; link only to that board.

pushCommentAddedReady.label: Pinned comment notification
pushCommentAddedReady.rule: Name the persisted comment’s author and layer; link to its thread.

layerEditorNewDraft.label: First layer draft
layerEditorNewDraft.rule: Create the first text layer in Autumn launch flow; its words and size stay local until saved.

layerEditorCreating.label: Creating first layer
layerEditorCreating.rule: Retain the first-layer text and property draft while preventing duplicate insertion.

layerEditorCreated.label: First layer saved
layerEditorCreated.rule: Show the acknowledged first layer and return to its newly created board.

layerEditorCreateFailed.label: First layer not saved
layerEditorCreateFailed.rule: Retain the first-layer draft; retry without inserting a second copy.

canvasFirstLayerSaved.label: First layer on board
canvasFirstLayerSaved.rule: Open Autumn launch flow at its acknowledged first text layer; tools remain available for the next layer.

layerEditorReviewDraft.label: Pinned layer draft
layerEditorReviewDraft.rule: Edit the Continue button identified by the selected comment; retain its text while moving it above the keyboard.

layerEditorReviewSaved.label: Pinned layer saved
layerEditorReviewSaved.rule: Show the acknowledged Continue button position before returning to resolve its feedback.

canvasReviewSaved.label: Pinned layer revision saved
canvasReviewSaved.rule: Show the acknowledged Continue button above the keyboard before resolving its pinned feedback.

shareBoardEvent.label: Grant board access and send invitation

beginTextLayerEvent.label: Add the board’s first text layer

flows.goal: Create a named board, add its first text layer and reopen the saved result.
flows.ends: Autumn launch flow has a saved identity and its first text layer is present in the acknowledged board revision.

binding.because: Naming the blank board is a bounded form; the first layer is then edited in its canvas context.

flows.goal: Edit a layer and reopen the acknowledged board revision.
flows.ends: The reopened board contains the saved button text and property changes.

binding.because: Layer properties must stay beside the layer’s position and neighbors.

flows.goal: Reply to feedback, change its layer and acknowledge resolution.
flows.ends: The corrected layer is saved and the thread is acknowledged as resolved with history retained.

flows.goal: Give a teammate access to this board, not every board.
flows.ends: The recipient can open the named board without gaining unrelated board access.

flows.goal: Create a local image of selected frames.
flows.ends: A complete local image is ready to download; the board revision is unchanged.

flows.goal: Remove an unwanted frame after reviewing its children.
flows.ends: The acknowledged revision no longer contains the named frame or its four child layers.

flows.goal: Choose grid, snapping and comment notifications.
flows.ends: Reopening preferences retains the guide and notification choices.

flows.goal: Understand which edits are local and which teammates can see.
flows.ends: The designer distinguishes pending local changes from an acknowledged shared revision.

flows.goal: Understand Tilework and open the team’s board collection.
flows.ends: The designer reaches saved boards and the named-blank-board creation path.

flows.goal: Open a persisted pinned comment from an opted-in notification.
flows.ends: The comment opens beside its layer with a real reply action.

surfaces.question: Which shared board should I open or create?

binding.because: Recently edited shared boards are the starting point for continued design work.

surfaces.question: What should this new blank board be called?
How do these screens, notes and connectors form one flow?

slots.because: Deleting the named frame removes its child layers from the shared board; confirm that exact scope before submitting.
The acknowledged revision stays beside the board rather than disappearing in a toast.

setups.label: Delete Welcome and its four layers

surfaces.question: What should change in this layer’s text, dimensions and placement?
Which layer needs feedback, and has its thread been resolved?

binding.because: Pinned feedback must stay beside the exact layer it describes while a designer replies or resolves it.

surfaces.question: Which guide, comment and default export options should I keep for my boards?

binding.because: Grid, guides and default export choices affect one designer and fit one sectioned page.

surfaces.question: How do frames, layers and pinned comments behave when my board is offline?
Can I keep product screens, flow notes and review feedback together?
Who invited me to which board, and what does opening it grant me?
Who left feedback on which layer, and where can I reply?
